notes: Stored edit, no worlds (mathematics has none). The author of the Elements is reached through written_by, which is functional: after the edit the author is Archimedes, and the facts the record stores about Archimedes (and not about Euclid) carry over. The related question is the inverse reading (author_of). The Eureka and screw-pump facts are classes (EurekaShouter, ScrewPumpDesigner) because RELATIONS.md has no relation for them.
